name: feature-flag-rollout
title: Feature Flag Rollout
description: Reads back who gets the flag (segments plus a percentage of everyone else, in users), asks for a second click before production skips ramp steps or gets ahead of staging, and warns how many users lose the feature on a pullback.

meta.stops: Feature flag released to everyone early
meta.summary: Reads back exactly who gets a feature flag and asks again before production skips ramp steps, so a flag isn't released to everyone early.
meta.server: Enforce rollout rules and approvals in the flag service, and keep an audit log of changes.
catches: Production rollouts that skip ramp steps
Who actually gets the flag, counted in users
How many users lose the feature on a pullback
limits: User counts come from the segment sizes you pass
Saving runs your callback; the flag service decides real exposure
a11y: Each environment is a fieldset with a legend; the slider has a <label> and an aria-valuetext readback
Segments are a labelled group of aria-pressed toggles
Warnings are aria-live="polite"; save status uses role="status"
